compile_grammar_structured_output: compile a grammar specification into a structured output grammar for a given request type
allocate_token_bitmask: allocate a token bitmask tensor for the specified maximum number of sequences
accept_tokens_grammar: accept or reject generated tokens against a compiled structured output grammar for a request
validate_tokens_grammar: validate a list of token IDs against a structured output grammar without advancing the FSM
fill_bitmask_grammar: fill a torch bitmask tensor for a specific batch index using the structured output grammar
